items.name: Club
items.description: This category includes all types of simple, one-piece bludgeons—humanity’s oldest weapon. Clubs range from natural sticks and bones to carved stone or wood to modern nightsticks and truncheons of hard wood, plastic, or even metal. The combat statistics for a club also apply to any heavy, club-like object a character picks up to use in a fight, such as a table leg or a lead pipe.

items.name: Dagger
items.description: All knives, stilettos, and other such weapons are included in this category (except for the combat knife, which has its own entry).

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.description: While this stout rod of wood—or metal or plastic at high Progress Levels—isn't particularly deadly, it's easy to use (note its accuracy bonus).

items.name: Spear
items.description: A primitive spear consists of a wooden shaft with a sharpened stone or bone head. At higher Progress Levels, spears have metal or synthetic heads.

items.name: Gauntlet
items.description: This weapon is a metal sheath that fits over the outside of the hand, providing slightly better damage potential in a fistfight than one’s bare knuckles.

items.name: Hand ax
items.description: A tool that became a weapon, the hand ax consists of a short wooden handle with a heavy, single-edged cutting head. Primitive axes can be made from carved stone, but the majority of axes at higher Progress Levels have metal heads.

items.name: Mace
items.description: A mace is a club with a blunt stone or iron head fitted to one end. Some of the heads may be studded, flanged, or spiked.

items.name: Short sword
items.description: The short sword consists of a handle designed for one-handed use and a blade that's longer than a dagger's—any blade just over 0.5 meters in length. The blade is pointed and used for thrusting.

items.name: Broad sword
items.description: The heavy, double-edged broad sword features a meter-long blade designed for both cutting and slashing.

items.name: Flail
items.description: The common threshing flail, modified for war, is a potent weapon. It consists of a sturdy wooden handle attached by a chain to an iron rod, a spiked rod, or a spiked iron ball.

items.name: Great ax
items.description: This weapon consists of a stout wooden shaft, 2 meters long, with a curved, single-edged blade at one end; it does impressive damage but takes two hands to wield.

items.name: Nunchaku
items.description: A nunchaku consists of two wooden or metal bars joined by a chain or a hinge. It can deliver powerful blows, and provides a +1 bonus to parry checks.

items.name: Polearm
items.description: Polearms are a class of weapons consisting of a long shaft with an edged weapon mounted at one end. These weapons require two hands to use.

items.name: Cutlass
items.description: The weapon made famous by pirates, the cutlass features a curved, single-edged blade and a heavy basket hilt.

items.name: Katana
items.description: This is the sword of the samurai. It features a slightly curved blade with a chisel point and a small, circular guard. The katana is forged from the finest steel, and its careful construction yields a blade of great strength and flexibility.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: Along, slender blade designed for thrusting, used primarily in duels and fencing.

items.name: Saber
items.description: The favorite cavalry weapon, the saber has a slightly curved blade that gives maximum slashing power.

items.name: Bayonet
items.description: Originally a dagger designed to be attached to a rifle’s muzzle, the bayonet occasionally becomes a primary weapon in its own right. In effect, a bayonet turns a rifle into a spear.

items.name: Combat knife
items.description: This weapon is a high-tech version of the standard knife, typically composed of tempered steel, sophisticated polymers, or ceramics.

items.name: Stun baton
items.description: This low-powered version of the pulse baton is sometimes known as a taser. Its surface crackles with a high-voltage, low-current electrical charge that can temporarily short-circuit the human nervous system. Insulated gloves are necessary to prevent the user from accidentally shocking himself.

items.name: Chainsword
items.description: This device consists of a meter-long blade with a motorized, rotating chain of razor-sharp teeth.

items.name: Pulse baton
items.description: An improved version of the stun baton, the pulse baton delivers a massive electrical discharge upon impact.

items.name: Gravmace
items.description: The gravmace consists of a meter-long handle with a gravitationally active striking head. Powerful capacitors manipulate the weapon’s mass, making it lighter when being swung and much heavier upon impact.

items.name: Power Cestus
items.description: This weapon consists of a heavy fighting glove reinforced with carbonate fiber and powered by a small energy cell, allowing the wielder to deliver blows of astonishing power.

items.name: Star sword
items.description: This weapon generates a containment field in the shape of a blade, and then fills the interior of this field with white-hot plasma. On contact, the containment field releases a stream of plasma that can burn or cut through almost anything. A star sword is difficult to use and often damages an untrained wielder.

items.name: Tri-staff
items.description: This 2-meter-long staff is topped by a three-pronged blade. When the staff is activated, an internal power source suffuses it with a soft glow. This aura acts as a defensive force field that improves the Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers of its wielder by 1 step.

items.name: Bow, short
items.description: This is a simple bow made from a single piece of wood. It is the earliest and most widespread form of archery.

items.name: Sling
items.description: A simple strap of leather used to hurl stones or lead bullets with surprising force.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: A light throwing spear, sometimes fashioned from metal or weighted for stability. Its balance and mass make it an ideal throwing weapon.

items.name: Bow, long
items.description: A larger, more powerful version of the short bow, used primarily for its range and accuracy.

items.name: Crossbow
items.description: A bow mounted crosswise on a wooden or metal stock, fired much like a gun. It's slower but has superior range and striking power.

items.name: Shuriken
items.description: Small, flat throwing stars made of metal, easily concealed and designed to inflict wounds or distract enemies.

items.name: Musket, flintlock
items.description: The earliest form of common black powder firearm, inaccurate and slow-loading, but powerful at close range.

items.name: Pistol, flintlock
items.description: A small handgun that uses a flintlock mechanism, popular for self-defense and dueling.

items.name: Rifle, long
items.description: Also known as the Kentucky rifle, this flintlock weapon features rifled barrels for significantly improved accuracy over a smoothbore musket.

items.name: Derringer
items.description: A very small, easily concealed pistol, typically having two barrels and used as a backup weapon.

items.name: Pistol, .38 rev
items.description: A standard, reliable handgun that uses a rotating cylinder to hold multiple rounds.

items.name: Pistol, .44 magnum
items.description: A powerful handgun known for its high stopping power and heavy recoil.

items.name: Rifle, 7.62mm
items.description: A standard bolt-action battle rifle, accurate and reliable over long distances.

items.name: Rifle, assault
items.description: The first firearm capable of both burst fire and full-automatic fire, becoming the standard military weapon of its era.

items.name: SMG, 9mm
items.description: A small but deadly automatic weapon with a high rate of fire, ideal for close-quarters combat.

items.name: Pistol, 9mm ch
items.description: An electrochemical weapon that uses an electrical shock to ignite its propellant, resulting in much higher muzzle velocities than conventional firearms.

items.name: Pistol, 9mm zero-g
items.description: A charge pistol with a sophisticated anti-recoil system, allowing it to be used in weightless conditions without affecting the wielder's movement.

items.name: Rifle, 11mm ch
items.description: A heavier version of the charge rifle, firing larger rounds with greater range and damage.

items.name: Shotgun, autoflec
items.description: A high-tech shotgun that fires a cloud of tiny flechettes (needle-like projectiles) and is capable of semi-automatic fire.

items.name: Pistol, 15mm sabot
items.description: Fires high-velocity, sub-caliber projectiles that can penetrate most personal armor with ease.

items.name: Pistol, laser
items.description: Uses an electrical charge to fire a focused, white-hot beam of light that can burn through many materials.

items.name: Pistol, mass
items.description: Utilizes gravity induction technology to fire a short-lived artificial mass singularity, causing horrible tidal damage to its target.

items.name: Pistol, stutter
items.description: A non-lethal sonic weapon that uses low-frequency rumbles to incapacitate a target with stun damage.

items.name: Rifle, laser
items.description: A larger, heavier version of the laser pistol, with much greater range and accuracy.

items.name: Rifle, quantum
items.description: A personal version of the ship-mounted particle beam, firing subatomic particles at a target with lethal force.

items.name: Rifle, render
items.description: Uses gravity induction technology to rapidly alternate attraction and repulsion, literally tearing the target apart.

items.name: Automaser
items.description: A submachine-gun version of maser technology, providing high-rate energy blasts for rapid fire.

items.name: Pistol, maser
items.description: Fires a blast of microwave energy that generates intense heat within the target's body.

items.name: Rifle, maser
items.description: A larger, more powerful version of the maser pistol, capable of inflicting severe internal damage at longer ranges.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.description: Uses a tank of liquid fuel to project a stream of burning fire, capable of engulfing several targets in its path.

items.name: Grenade, frag
items.description: A standard grenade designed to scatter razor-sharp fragments in all directions upon detonation.

items.name: Machine gun, .30
items.description: A light, air-cooled machine gun that fires rapid bursts of ammunition to suppress enemies.

items.name: Rocket launcher
items.description: An anti-tank weapon that fires a rocket-propelled grenade to inflict massive damage on vehicles and buildings.

items.name: Grenade launcher
items.description: A separate weapon specifically designed to fire small, high-explosive grenades.

items.name: Grenade, concus.
items.description: Uses a powerful blast of air pressure to stun or knock out enemies without causing lethal wounds.

items.name: Grenade, incend.
items.description: Designed to ignite on impact, starting fires and burning anyone within its blast radius.

items.name: Grenade, smoke
items.description: A non-lethal grenade that releases a thick cloud of smoke to obscure vision.

items.name: Hvy machine gun
items.description: A larger, more powerful machine gun that can penetrate light armor and suppress large areas.

items.name: SAM, handheld
items.description: A man-portable surface-to-air missile launcher used to shoot down low-flying aircraft.

items.name: Bantam launcher
items.description: A high-tech rocket launcher that can fire several different types of specialized "Bantam" missiles.

items.name: Bantam, antiair
items.description: A missile designed to track and destroy fast-moving aerial targets.

items.name: Bantam, antiper.
items.description: An anti-personnel missile designed to maximize its blast radius and fragmentation.

items.name: Bantam, antiveh.
items.description: A missile with a shaped-charge warhead designed to penetrate heavy armor.

items.name: Grenade, plasma
items.description: Releases a burst of superheated plasma that can burn through almost any material.

items.name: Grenade, stun
items.description: A non-lethal grenade that uses a flash of light and a loud noise to daze and disorient enemies.

items.name: Rail gun
items.description: Uses electromagnetic coils to accelerate a metal slug to incredibly high velocities.

items.name: Arc gun
items.description: Projects a bolt of high-voltage electricity that can arc between multiple targets.

items.name: Cannon, stutter
items.description: A larger, more powerful version of the stutter pistol, capable of incapacitating many enemies at once.

items.name: Cannon, 25mm sabot
items.description: A heavy weapon that fires large, high-velocity sabot rounds designed to destroy heavy vehicles.

items.name: Grenade, pulse
items.description: Emits a powerful electromagnetic pulse (EMP) that can disable electronics and cybernetics.

items.name: Grenade, tracer
items.description: A specialized grenade that releases a swarm of tiny sensors to track and mark targets.

items.name: Plasma gun
items.description: A larger, more powerful version of the plasma grenade, capable of firing repeated bursts of superheated plasma.

items.name: Quantum mini
items.description: A personal version of the particle beam cannon, firing subatomic particles with devastating force.

items.name: Bantam, starload
items.description: A missile that uses a miniature mass reactor to create a massive explosion, targeting both people and vehicles.

items.name: Cannon, maser
items.description: A heavy energy weapon that uses a mass reactor to supply the power for destructive maser blasts.

items.name: Grenade, mass
items.description: Detonates a tiny mass reactor to create a small but destructive singularity that destroys anything in its vicinity.

items.name: Mass launcher
items.description: An indirect-fire weapon that launches waves of gravity energy, using the planet's gravity well to magnify its power.
